stories.title: Manitobans brace for dark mornings, lighter evenings after time change nixed

en.title: Manitobans brace for dark mornings, lighter evenings after time change nixed
en.summary: Manitoba will no longer observe daylight saving time starting in November, Premier Wab Kinew announced. Mental health advocates view the elimination of the time change positively.

stories.title: FBI stopped working with RCMP after CBC 9/11 memo, report says; Doug Ford takes back ‘endorsement’ of Toronto mayor; and more

en.title: FBI stopped working with RCMP after CBC 9/11 memo, report says; Doug Ford takes back 'endorsement' of Toronto mayor; and more

stories.title: Xenon stock plunges as B.C. drug developer pauses enrolment in depression study
stories.outlet: The Globe and Mail (Report on Business)

en.title: Xenon stock plunges as B.C. drug developer pauses enrolment in depression study
en.summary: Xenon Pharmaceuticals' stock price fell after the British Columbia-based company halted enrollment in a depression study. The pause occurred while the company sought FDA approval to market an anti-seizure drug for epilepsy treatment in the United States.
